note: SETTINGS PLANE: per-hub OPERATIONAL policy for populating each Open*Hub. Merged with hub_population_strategy.json (sources + bars) by src/openharnesshub/hub_settings.py into a resolved HubSettings. Knobs: enabled, cadence (cycles between populating), rate_limit_per_cycle (max candidates/cycle), tool_allowlist ([]=all tool names), auto_verify (run the verify gate automatically), visibility (global|tenant_first). Edit via `scripts/hub_engine_runner.py --set <hub> key=val` (validated) or a UI like config_ui_server. Absent hubs fall back to defaults. serves_truth=false.
